verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Authenticator can mirror notifications to a wearable device, suggesting some smartwatch surface exists, but there's no explicit confirmation that OTP codes (not just approval prompts) are viewable on a smartwatch without touching the phone. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on confirmation that time-based codes display on a smartwatch face, details on which wearables/OS are supported, and any independent user corroboration of this specific use case.
